meta.title: Native Maskin LLM Subscription — OpenRouter Routing, Billing Data Model, Usage Tracking
meta.summary: Adds a Maskin-funded LLM tier so workspaces can run agents without supplying their own Anthropic credentials. Introduces a billing data model (plan/Stripe/caps stored in workspace.settings.billing), routes paid/trial plans through Maskin's OpenRouter account, enforces hard-cap limits before session creation (HTTP 402 on breach), implements Stripe checkout + webhook lifecycle, and adds a mutual-exclusion layer that auto-cancels a paid subscription when the user adds a BYO key.

graphs.label: System overview
graphs.summary: Stable architecture for the LLM routing and billing subsystem. Shows the five stable components a reviewer needs to understand before reading the diff.

nodes.title: LLM Routing
nodes.summary: apps/dev/src/lib/llm-routing.ts — Priority chain that resolves which LLM credentials to inject into an agent container session. Six tiers in descending priority: (1) agent-level API key override, (2) Maskin-funded plan (trial/starter/pro via OpenRouter), (3) workspace custom_llm endpoint, (4) Claude OAuth subscription, (5) workspace Anthropic API key, (6) system fallback (shared OpenRouter key, daily quota). The chosen route tag ('maskin_plan', 'system_fallback', etc.) is persisted on sessions.config.llm_route so usage attribution and cap enforcement can query it cheaply.
details: resolveLlmRoute() runs on every POST /api/sessions call via session-manager.ts.
buildMaskinPlanEnv() returns the OpenRouter env block for plans in {trial, starter, pro}.
checkPlanCap() sums maskin_plan session tokens for the workspace since period_start and throws PlanCapExceededError (HTTP 402) when the sum >= hard_cap_tokens.
getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage() is also used by GET /api/billing/usage to power the progress bar in Settings.
The fallback tier shares the same MASKIN_FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY — the operator's single OR account underwrites both.

nodes.title: Workspace Settings Schema
nodes.summary: packages/shared/src/schemas/workspaces.ts — Zod schema that governs every per-workspace configuration field stored in the workspaces.settings jsonb column. Relevant sub-schemas: billing (plan enum, Stripe IDs, period timestamps, hard_cap_tokens, status), llm_keys (anthropic / openai), custom_llm (enabled, base_url, api_key, model), claude_oauth (encrypted tokens). The schema is the single source of truth consumed by both the backend (Drizzle queries, route validation) and the frontend (type inference).
details: plan enum: trial | starter | pro | byollm. Trial routes through Maskin OR; byollm means BYO is active.
hard_cap_tokens written by the Stripe webhook when a subscription activates.
period_start / period_end are Stripe current_period_start / current_period_end in Unix seconds.
Partial Zod parse (.partial().safeParse()) is used defensively at read time to avoid crashing on legacy rows.

nodes.title: Session Manager
nodes.summary: apps/dev/src/services/session-manager.ts — Orchestrates Docker container creation for agent sessions. Before inserting the session row, it calls resolveLlmRoute() to determine LLM credentials and checkPlanCap() for a pre-flight cap check. If the cap is exceeded, the caller gets HTTP 402 before any row is created. The resolved route is stored on sessions.config.llm_route so billing attribution and usage queries can filter by route without touching container logs.
details: checkPlanCap() runs before the DB INSERT — a 402 response leaves the sessions table untouched.
resolveLlmRoute() result's envVars are merged into the container environment at startup.
sessions.inputTokens / outputTokens are written by parseUsageFromLogChunks() when the container finishes, making token sums cheap to query.

nodes.title: Billing API Routes
nodes.summary: apps/dev/src/routes/billing.ts + stripe-webhook.ts — Two route files that form the billing API surface. billing.ts exposes GET /api/billing/usage (current plan + tokens_used + resets_in) and POST /api/billing/checkout (creates a Stripe Checkout session and returns the hosted URL). stripe-webhook.ts handles inbound Stripe events: verifies signature, deduplicates via a webhookDeliveries table, and writes billing fields (plan, hard_cap_tokens, period_start/end, status) back to workspace.settings.
details: POST /api/billing/checkout reads the existing stripe_customer_id to reuse the Stripe Customer across plan upgrades.
Stripe events handled: checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, invoice.paid/payment_failed.
Webhook deduplication: webhookDeliveries table with a unique (provider, external_event_id) index prevents double-processing.
On paid plan activation (checkout.session.completed), settingsAfterPaidPlanActivation() strips BYO keys from settings atomically.

nodes.title: Billing Settings UI
nodes.summary: apps/web/src/components/settings/billing-section.tsx — Settings panel rendered under Settings → Keys. Shows the active plan label, a status badge (Active/Past due/Canceled), a token-usage progress bar (X / Y tokens · resets in Nd), and upgrade/downgrade CTAs. useBillingUsage() polls GET /api/billing/usage; useStripeCheckout() calls POST /api/billing/checkout and redirects to the returned Stripe URL. A 'Switch to bring-your-own' dialog explains that saving any BYO credential will atomically cancel the paid subscription.
details: Progress bar turns warning-colored at 85% and error-colored at 100%.
formatTokens() renders large token counts as '32M', '96M' etc.
The Stripe billing portal link (manage subscription, invoices) is shown only for paid plans with a stripe_customer_id.

tour.title: Start with the data model
tour.body: The billing field in workspaces.settings is the central state that every other component reads. Understanding its shape — plan enum, Stripe IDs, period timestamps, hard_cap_tokens — is the prerequisite for following the rest of the change.

tour.title: LLM routing priority chain
tour.body: resolveLlmRoute() is the function that decides which credentials land in the agent container. The new 'maskin_plan' tier sits at priority #2, above BYO sources. The route tag persisted on sessions.config.llm_route is what makes token attribution cheap — it's a filter, not a join.

tour.title: Pre-flight cap check at session creation
tour.body: The cap check runs before the DB INSERT for a session, so an over-cap workspace gets HTTP 402 without creating a half-formed row. This is the contract the over-cap banner UI task (dcfe3afe) depends on.

tour.title: Stripe checkout and webhook lifecycle
tour.body: billing.ts initiates checkout; stripe-webhook.ts closes the loop by writing plan/cap/period back to workspace.settings when Stripe fires events. The mutual-exclusion stripping (BYO keys removed on paid plan activation) also happens here.

tour.title: The user-visible surface
tour.body: BillingSection in Settings → Keys is the only UI surface this PR adds. It's wired to the same /api/billing/usage endpoint that the cap enforcement reads, so the progress bar and the 402 logic share a single usage number.

graphs.label: Data flow graph
graphs.summary: How billing state, Stripe events, token counts, and cap decisions move through the system.

nodes.title: User: start checkout
nodes.summary: User clicks 'Upgrade to Starter/Pro' in Settings → Keys. Frontend calls POST /api/billing/checkout.
details: useStripeCheckout() mutation in apps/web/src/hooks/use-billing.ts fires POST /api/billing/checkout with {plan, success_url, cancel_url}.
On success, window.location.href is set to the returned Stripe hosted checkout URL.

nodes.title: POST /api/billing/checkout
nodes.summary: Creates a Stripe Checkout session and returns the hosted URL. Reuses existing stripe_customer_id if present.
details: Reads workspace settings to find existing stripe_customer_id — ensures the same Stripe Customer is reused across plan changes.
Calls createCheckoutSession() which embeds workspaceId in client_reference_id and subscription metadata for webhook resolution.
readStripeEnv() at request time throws 500 if Stripe vars are missing — fails clearly rather than silently.

nodes.title: POST /api/webhooks/stripe
nodes.summary: Verifies Stripe signature, deduplicates via webhookDeliveries table, and writes billing fields back to workspace.settings.
details: Event types handled: checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.{created,updated,deleted}, invoice.{paid,payment_failed}.
resolveWorkspaceIdFromEvent() tries client_reference_id first, then object.metadata.workspace_id.
On checkout.session.completed: writes billing.plan, billing.hard_cap_tokens, billing.period_start, billing.status = 'active' and strips BYO keys via settingsAfterPaidPlanActivation().
On invoice.paid: updates period_start, period_end, resets hard_cap_tokens from env for the renewal period.
Dedup: INSERT INTO webhook_deliveries ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING — if already processed, returns {ok:true, skipped:true, reason:'already_processed'}.

nodes.title: workspaces.settings.billing
nodes.summary: Jsonb field on the workspaces row. Ground truth for plan, Stripe IDs, period dates, cap, and subscription status.
details: plan: 'trial' | 'starter' | 'pro' | 'byollm'
hard_cap_tokens: written by webhook on activation; falls back to env defaults (MASKIN_STARTER_HARD_CAP_TOKENS etc.) when null.
period_start / period_end: Stripe current_period_start / current_period_end in Unix seconds.
status: 'active' | 'past_due' | 'canceled' | 'incomplete' — mirrors Stripe subscription status.

nodes.title: POST /api/sessions → pre-flight cap check
nodes.summary: session-manager.createSession() runs checkPlanCap() then resolveLlmRoute() before inserting the session row. A cap breach surfaces as HTTP 402 with no row created.
details: checkPlanCap() sums maskin_plan tokens since period_start for the workspace. Throws PlanCapExceededError({ plan, used, cap, period_end }) if used >= cap.
resolveLlmRoute() returns {route: 'maskin_plan', envVars: {ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_MODEL}} for paid/trial plans.
app.onError in app-factory.ts catches PlanCapExceededError and returns HTTP 402 with {error:{code:'PLAN_CAP_EXCEEDED', plan, used, cap, period_end}}.
trial plan uses MASKIN_TRIAL_HARD_CAP_TOKENS (default 100k) as its cap.

nodes.title: sessions.config.llm_route
nodes.summary: Each session row records llm_route='maskin_plan'. This tag is the filter used by token-usage queries — no need to join logs or decode container env.
details: Existing behavior — session-manager already persisted llm_route in config. No schema change needed.
inputTokens + outputTokens columns accumulate as the container runs; parsed from Claude Code usage output at session end.
getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage() queries sessions WHERE workspaceId AND llm_route='maskin_plan' AND createdAt >= period_start.

nodes.title: getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage()
nodes.summary: Sums input+output tokens across maskin_plan sessions for a workspace since period_start. Used by both the cap check and the billing usage API.
details: A single Drizzle query: SELECT inputTokens, outputTokens FROM sessions WHERE workspaceId = ? AND config->>'llm_route' = 'maskin_plan' AND createdAt >= periodStart.
Null tokens treated as 0 — safe for sessions that haven't finished yet.
periodStartMs defaults to all-time (no date filter) for trial workspaces without a Stripe period.

nodes.title: GET /api/billing/usage
nodes.summary: Returns {plan, status, tokens_used, hard_cap_tokens, period_start, period_resets_in_ms, stripe_customer_id, stripe_subscription_id} for the BillingSection progress bar.
details: Reads workspace.settings.billing; if missing, treats workspace as trial.
Calls getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage() — same query path as the cap check.
period_resets_in_ms = max(0, periodEndMs - Date.now()) — the frontend formats this as 'resets in 14d'.
byollm plan: tokens_used returns 0 and period_resets_in_ms returns null.

tour.title: User initiates upgrade
tour.body: The flow starts in Settings → Keys. The user clicks 'Upgrade to Starter' and the frontend POSTs to /api/billing/checkout. Knowing this is the entry point helps orient the rest of the Stripe lifecycle.

tour.title: Checkout session creation
tour.body: The backend creates a Stripe Checkout session with workspaceId embedded in both client_reference_id and subscription metadata. This dual embedding is what lets the webhook handler resolve the workspace even if only one field survives across Stripe event types.

tour.title: Stripe event closes the loop
tour.body: On checkout.session.completed, the webhook writes billing fields to workspace.settings and strips any leftover BYO credentials via settingsAfterPaidPlanActivation(). Idempotent via webhookDeliveries dedup — safe to retry.

tour.title: Central state: workspace.settings.billing
tour.body: After the webhook runs, hard_cap_tokens and period_start are set. These two fields drive everything downstream — the cap check on session creation and the usage progress bar in Settings.

tour.title: Pre-flight cap check
tour.body: Before inserting a session row, checkPlanCap() runs. If the workspace has consumed >= hard_cap_tokens, the caller gets HTTP 402 with {code:'PLAN_CAP_EXCEEDED', used, cap, period_end}. No partial row is created. This is the contract the over-cap banner UI (future task) depends on.

tour.title: llm_route tag enables cheap attribution
tour.body: Recording llm_route='maskin_plan' on each session row means token usage can be aggregated with a simple WHERE filter — no log parsing needed. This is the key design decision that makes per-period usage queries O(sessions) rather than O(log-lines).

tour.title: Shared usage query path
tour.body: getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage() is called from both the cap enforcement path and the billing usage API. The progress bar in Settings shows the same number the cap check enforces — they cannot drift.

tour.title: Usage API feeds the UI
tour.body: GET /api/billing/usage returns the full snapshot the BillingSection needs. period_resets_in_ms lets the UI show 'resets in 14d' without any date arithmetic in the component.

graphs.label: Code dependency graph
graphs.summary: Which files depend on which. Entry points at left, shared libs at center, tests at right.

nodes.title: packages/shared: workspaces.ts
nodes.summary: Zod schema for WorkspaceSettings including the new billing sub-schema. Imported by every layer that reads or writes billing state.
details: billing.plan enum: 'trial' | 'starter' | 'pro' | 'byollm'
Adds billing.period_end (for cap error ETA display).
workspaceSettingsSchema.partial().safeParse() is the standard defensive read pattern used by billing.ts and stripe-webhook.ts.

nodes.title: lib/billing-defaults.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for cap literals (TRIAL_HARD_CAP_DEFAULT_TOKENS=100k, STARTER=32M, PRO=96M) and the parsePositiveIntEnv() helper.
details: parsePositiveIntEnv() uses a /^\d+$/ shape check before Number() to reject scientific notation, decimals, and underscores.
Clamps to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER to guard against pathological inputs like '1e308'.
A CI script (scripts/verify-billing-cap-literals.mjs) checks that .env.example and billing-section tests reference the same literal values — bump here and CI fails until all three are in sync.

nodes.title: lib/stripe.ts
nodes.summary: Stripe SDK wrapper: readStripeEnv(), getStripeClient(), createCheckoutSession(), verifyStripeWebhook(), and event helpers (resolveWorkspaceIdFromEvent, planForPriceId, hardCapForPlan, mapSubscriptionStatus).
details: readStripeEnv() throws at first-request if any required var is missing — no silent failures.
getStripeClient() is a module-level singleton; resetStripeClientForTests() drops the cache for test isolation.
resolveWorkspaceIdFromEvent(): tries client_reference_id (checkout), then metadata.workspace_id (subscription/invoice events).

nodes.title: lib/llm-routing.ts
nodes.summary: Core routing logic: resolveLlmRoute(), checkPlanCap(), PlanCapExceededError, getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage(). Central dependency for session creation and the billing usage API.
details: New in this PR: LLM_ROUTE_MASKIN_PLAN constant, buildMaskinPlanEnv(), checkPlanCap(), getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage(), PlanCapExceededError.
maskin_plan sits at priority #2 — below agent override, above custom_llm. trial is in MASKIN_PLAN_ROUTED_PLANS alongside starter/pro.

nodes.title: lib/llm-source-mutex.ts
nodes.summary: Pure functions implementing the BYOLLM ↔ paid plan mutual exclusion. hasActivePaidPlan(), cancelActivePaidSubscription(), billingAfterByoTransition(), settingsAfterPaidPlanActivation(), patchAddsByoSource().
details: Cancel-before-write order: Stripe cancel runs first; if it throws, the DB write is skipped so the workspace isn't stuck in byollm without actually canceling.
settingsAfterPaidPlanActivation() strips llm_keys.anthropic, custom_llm, and claude_oauth from settings in one immutable merge.
patchAddsByoSource() checks that the incoming PATCH is actually adding a key (not null/deleting) before triggering the mutex.

nodes.title: routes/billing.ts
nodes.summary: Hono route handler for GET /api/billing/usage and POST /api/billing/checkout.
details: Imports: billing-defaults (fallback caps), llm-routing (getWorkspacePlanTokenUsage), stripe (createCheckoutSession).
planHardCapFallback() — defensive read that won't throw if Stripe isn't configured, so /billing/usage works even for non-Stripe deployments.

nodes.title: routes/stripe-webhook.ts
nodes.summary: Handles inbound Stripe webhook events. Imports stripe.ts for verification/helpers and llm-source-mutex.ts for the paid-plan activation clearing logic.
details: Raw body read before Hono JSON parsing (required for Stripe signature verification).
Uses sql`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` for idempotent delivery via webhookDeliveries table.

nodes.title: routes/workspaces.ts (PATCH)
nodes.summary: PATCH /api/workspaces/:id is extended with BYOLLM mutex logic: if the patch adds a BYO key and there's an active paid plan, cancel Stripe and rewrite billing.
details: Imports llm-source-mutex.ts (patchAddsByoSource, hasActivePaidPlan, cancelActivePaidSubscription, billingAfterByoTransition).
Stripe cancel runs before DB update — failure surfaces as 5xx and leaves the row unchanged.
github-code-quality bot flagged an unused 'calls' destructuring in byollm-mutex.test.ts (line 190) — minor cleanup needed.

comments.body: Unused variable 'calls' in byollm-mutex.test.ts line 190. Remove from destructuring in the 'skips Stripe call when there is no live subscription' test case.

nodes.title: services/session-manager.ts
nodes.summary: Imports checkPlanCap and resolveLlmRoute from llm-routing.ts. Runs the pre-flight check before createSession's DB INSERT.
details: PlanCapExceededError propagates up to app.onError (app-factory.ts) which maps it to HTTP 402.
No schema changes to sessions table — llm_route was already persisted in config jsonb.

stripe-webhook.test.ts: checkout.session.completed writes correct fields; subscription.deleted clears plan; invoice.paid resets period.
byollm-mutex.test.ts: BYO key → Stripe cancel → plan=byollm; paid plan activation → BYO keys stripped.

tour.title: Schema is the root dependency
tour.body: Everything that reads or writes billing state imports the WorkspaceSettings type from packages/shared. Start here to understand what 'billing' means as a data shape before following the routes that read it.

tour.title: Cap literals are centralized
tour.body: billing-defaults.ts is the single source for TRIAL/STARTER/PRO hard cap defaults and the env parser. A CI script (verify-billing-cap-literals.mjs) enforces that .env.example and the frontend tests agree with these literals — change one, CI fails on the others.

tour.title: Stripe helpers are pure and testable
tour.body: stripe.ts wraps the Stripe SDK with pure helper functions (no route handlers). This makes billing.ts and stripe-webhook.ts easy to unit test by mocking just getStripeClient and verifyStripeWebhook.

tour.title: The new maskin_plan tier in routing
tour.body: llm-routing.ts is extended with buildMaskinPlanEnv(), checkPlanCap(), and PlanCapExceededError. This is the core of the bet — everything else is the billing lifecycle that keeps this routing tier in the right state.

tour.title: BYOLLM mutex is a pure module
tour.body: llm-source-mutex.ts has no side-effects — all pure functions. The Stripe cancel call happens in the route handler (workspaces.ts) before invoking billingAfterByoTransition(). This makes the mutex logic independently testable.

tour.title: Billing routes: checkout + usage
tour.body: billing.ts is a small two-endpoint file. The interesting detail is planHardCapFallback() — it reads env defensively (won't throw if Stripe is unconfigured) so /api/billing/usage keeps serving non-Stripe deployments.

tour.title: Webhook handler closes the Stripe loop
tour.body: stripe-webhook.ts is the most stateful piece — it writes billing fields on checkout completion and subscription events, and idempotently deduplicates via webhookDeliveries. Read the event dispatch table carefully.

tour.title: ~1500 lines of tests cover the new paths
tour.body: The test suite covers all routing precedence cases, all Stripe event types, mutex transitions in both directions, and the 402 error body shape. The github-code-quality bot flagged an unused 'calls' variable in byollm-mutex.test.ts line 190 — a minor cleanup.

graphs.label: User action graph
graphs.summary: What the user does and how each action flows through the implementation.

nodes.title: Navigate to Settings → Keys
nodes.summary: User opens the workspace settings keys page. The BillingSection component is rendered as the first section, above the BYO key inputs.
details: Route: apps/web/src/routes/_authed/$workspaceId/settings/keys.tsx
BillingSection is mounted with the workspaceId prop; useBillingUsage() fires GET /api/billing/usage immediately.
While loading: 'Loading…' placeholder. On error: error message. On success: plan card renders.

nodes.title: See plan card + usage bar
nodes.summary: BillingSection renders: plan label ('Trial', 'Starter — $20/mo', 'Pro — $60/mo', 'Bring-your-own'), status badge, token progress bar, and action buttons.
details: Progress bar: width = (tokens_used / hard_cap_tokens) * 100%. Turns warning at 85%, error at 100%.
formatTokens() renders 32000000 as '32M', 100000 as '100k'.
formatResetsIn() renders remaining ms as 'resets in 14d' / 'resets in 3h' / 'resets soon'.
For byollm: progress bar hidden, descriptive text shown instead.
Plan is 'trial' by default — no billing row needed.

nodes.title: Click 'Upgrade to Starter/Pro'
nodes.summary: User clicks an upgrade button. useStripeCheckout() fires POST /api/billing/checkout. On success, browser navigates to the Stripe hosted checkout URL.
details: Button is disabled while checkout.isPending to prevent double-submit.
success_url = current page + '?billing=success'; cancel_url = current page + '?billing=cancel'.
On checkout error: inline error message below the button row.

nodes.title: Complete payment on Stripe
nodes.summary: User completes the Stripe hosted checkout form. Stripe fires checkout.session.completed webhook and redirects back to success_url.
details: Stripe fires the webhook before the redirect — by the time the user lands on ?billing=success, billing fields may already be written.
The success_url redirect returns to settings/keys — BillingSection re-fetches /api/billing/usage and shows the new paid plan.

nodes.title: Click 'Switch to bring-your-own'
nodes.summary: For paid plan users: opens SwitchToByoDialog explaining that saving a BYO key will atomically cancel the Stripe subscription.
details: Dialog text: 'To cancel your paid plan, set up one of the bring-your-own options below — Claude subscription, Anthropic API key, or a custom model endpoint. Saving any of them cancels your active Maskin subscription atomically.'
Only shows for users on starter/pro with status=active.
After dismissing the dialog, user saves a BYO key in the rows below — that PATCH triggers the mutex.

nodes.title: Save a BYO key or endpoint
nodes.summary: User saves an Anthropic API key, custom endpoint, or Claude OAuth. PATCH /api/workspaces/:id triggers the mutex: Stripe subscription is canceled, billing.plan flips to 'byollm'.
details: patchAddsByoSource() detects the incoming key is non-null before triggering the mutex.
cancelActivePaidSubscription() tolerates 'resource_missing' (already canceled) so stale Stripe state can't block the transition.
After the workspace update, BillingSection re-fetches and shows plan='Bring-your-own', status='Inactive'.

nodes.title: Start session (cap exceeded → 402)
nodes.summary: User starts an agent session after consuming all plan tokens. checkPlanCap() throws PlanCapExceededError; the API returns HTTP 402 with {code:'PLAN_CAP_EXCEEDED', plan, used, cap, period_end}.
details: The 402 body is the contract for the over-cap banner UI (future task dcfe3afe) — period_end enables showing a reset ETA.
No session row is created — the pre-flight check runs before the DB INSERT.
trial plan: default cap is 100k tokens (MASKIN_TRIAL_HARD_CAP_TOKENS env, default 100k).

edges.label: switch button shown for active paid plan
redirect back → re-fetches usage, shows paid plan
plan flips to byollm → re-fetches usage

tour.title: Entry point: Settings → Keys
tour.body: The BillingSection is mounted here. On load it fetches /api/billing/usage — the first network request in the user journey. No billing row → trial plan shown by default.

tour.title: The plan card is the user's billing dashboard
tour.body: This component shows everything the user needs at a glance: plan, status, token consumption, and time until reset. It's driven entirely by GET /api/billing/usage — no client-side state.

tour.title: Upgrade initiates a Stripe redirect
tour.body: The upgrade button calls POST /api/billing/checkout and immediately navigates to the returned URL. This is a hard navigation (window.location.href), not a React route change — the user leaves the app briefly.

tour.title: Stripe fires the webhook before the redirect
tour.body: Stripe's webhook is typically delivered before the user is redirected back to success_url. The billing fields should already be written by the time BillingSection re-renders on the success URL.

tour.title: Switching to BYO cancels the Stripe sub
tour.body: The dialog surfaces the atomicity guarantee to the user: saving any BYO key cancels the paid plan in the same backend write. This prevents a workspace from being charged while running on a BYO key.

tour.title: The mutex runs in the PATCH handler
tour.body: PATCH /api/workspaces/:id is the trigger. patchAddsByoSource() detects the incoming key, cancelActivePaidSubscription() runs first (Stripe-side), then billingAfterByoTransition() writes the local state. Order matters: Stripe failure surfaces as 5xx and leaves the row unchanged.

tour.title: Over-cap: 402 before any row is created
tour.body: When tokens_used >= hard_cap_tokens, checkPlanCap() throws PlanCapExceededError. app.onError maps it to HTTP 402 with {code, plan, used, cap, period_end}. The period_end field lets the future over-cap banner show 'resets in Xd' without a separate API call.
